meta.disclaimer: Wildlife movements depend on rainfall and local conditions — use this calendar for trip timing, not as a guarantee of sightings.

highlights.title: Elephant concentrations — dry season
highlights.description: Waterholes and rivers draw hundreds of elephants. Chobe River cruises and Hwange pumped pans peak Jul–Oct. Etosha's Okaukuejo waterhole is legendary at dusk.

highlights.title: Calving season — predator action
highlights.description: Green season births attract lions and wild dogs. Lower rates and lush photography — some remote camps close for rains.

highlights.title: African wild dog denning
highlights.description: Packs stay near dens — exceptional viewing for photographers. Mana Pools and Moremi concessions most reliable.

highlights.title: Whale sharks & manta rays
highlights.description: Snorkelling with whale sharks peaks in warmer months. Combine with Bazaruto dhow sailing in shoulder season.

highlights.title: Sardine Run
highlights.description: Massive bait balls along the east coast draw dolphins, sharks, and gannets — weather-dependent spectacle.

highlights.title: Flamingo & pelican breeding
highlights.description: Coastal lagoons pink with greater and lesser flamingos. Walvis Bay boat tours best at high tide.

highlights.title: Straw-coloured fruit bat migration
highlights.description: Millions of bats darken the sky at Kasanka — one of Africa's greatest wildlife spectacles. Book lodges a year ahead.

highlights.title: Loggerhead & leatherback turtles
highlights.region: iSimangaliso, South Africa · Maputo Special Reserve
highlights.description: Night beach walks with licensed guides to see nesting turtles — strict red-torch protocols.

highlights.title: Zebra migration
highlights.description: Second-largest zebra migration follows rains into the salt pans — green season wonder with lower camp rates.

highlights.title: Emerald-season birding
highlights.description: Migratory birds, breeding plumage, and dramatic skies. Victoria Falls full spray Nov–Apr — pack rain gear.

highlights.title: Desert-adapted lions & rhinos
highlights.description: Track desert-adapted elephant and black rhino on foot with community guides — cool mornings, clear skies.

highlights.title: Humpback whales
highlights.description: Southern right and humpback whales visible from shore in Hermanus (SA) and off Vilanculos/Bazaruto (Mozambique).
